title: Any ship of ours gives the phase crystal it stores at First Step Memorial Station to the trader named there (strict classes)
note: 2026-11-25 13:16 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-093 P5 and block ZERO (give where a receiver stands), rules F23, F24. Confederacy Central Command (Sol) bids 110 x 785 for phase crystal (table books 13:07 UTC), the station here bids 1 to 2 cr; no open need names phase crystal (tool stock, view surplus, 13:09 UTC). A ship within one jump (max_jumps 1) whose own storage here holds 50 or more gives it to the trader named for this station (data/fleet/receivers.json, handover.py); Trade's carry-phase-first-step-to-sol carries it to Sol. Class deliver: every role; each Admiral puts it in its own plan or leaves it out.
